description: Every pump.fun coin a Solana wallet created in the last 10 days, how many graduated, and the wallets that bundle its launches again and again (its private bundle crew). Serial launchers (more than one coin a day) are the strongest rug signal in our tests: calls on coins whose creator launched another coin in the prior 24 h averaged −11% vs −5% after costs. Repeat block-0 wallets across a creator's launches are its own bundle wallets. When to use: For a dev's launch count and its repeat bundle crew; for graduation stats use pump_dev (on the MAD Synapse · Pump & LP server, https://agent.maddegen.art/hub/mcp/pump). Price: $0.002 per call (10 free/day; after that a payment-required result lists x402 options). Errors: returns isError with a message for invalid input or an upstream failure (not charged).
